name: claude-workbench
description: The way-of-working plugin: a portable Claude Code session-handoff protocol, review agents, hooks, and Global Conventions, parameterized per repo by .ai/project.yml.

plugins.name: way-of-working
plugins.description: Session handoff protocol (/way-of-working:resume, /way-of-working:handoff, /way-of-working:critic-gate, /way-of-working:ship, /way-of-working:pr-checks, /way-of-working:archive-sprint, /way-of-working:retro, /way-of-working:park-sprint, /way-of-working:unpark-sprint, /way-of-working:plan-sprint, /way-of-working:spec-task, /way-of-working:architect-review), the architect/coder/security-critic/docs-consistency agents and the read-only transcript-reader agent, and the Global Conventions — parameterized by each repo's .ai/project.yml.
